description: CLI for the repeated GitLab administration jobs: creating groups and projects, and inviting people to a group. Works against self-hosted GitLab and gitlab.com, with per-instance credential profiles.
rules: Credentials live in an INI file at ~/.gitlab-op/credentials, one section per profile, each with url and token. There is no --profile flag.
The active profile comes from the GITLAB_OP_PROFILE environment variable and defaults to 'default'.
Every command writes to a live GitLab instance. There is no dry-run, no confirmation prompt and no undo.
invite sends real email, potentially to people without an account yet. Confirm the address list before running it.
Groups are addressed by slug — the URL path segment, not the display name. new-group takes the slug first and the display name second.
new-project takes the full group-slug/project-slug path, not just the project slug.
Create the group before creating a project in it or inviting anyone: both look it up by slug and fail if it is missing.
The token needs GitLab API scope; a read-only token cannot create groups or projects.
Release archives follow goreleaser's uname-compatible template: gitlab-op_Darwin_arm64.tar.gz, capitalised OS and x86_64 rather than amd64, with no version in the name.
